text:
julia: FYI ingestion shows a burst of late events in EU (2-3h lag). Recompute queue is jumping and shared pools are feeling it. Can we route non-urgent replays to spot/dedicated to protect live traffic? cc @peter @rashid

peter: Quick guardrails: we need a deterministic rule for "non-urgent". Suggest: replay.meta.backfill_ok == true OR replay.priority == "background" OR window_end < now()-2h.

rashid: Agreed. Also propose a pre-scheduler dedupe pass for late arrivals: sample keys, skip ones already applied within X hours. Saves token spend.

julia: Good. If we add a `tier_hint=spot_fallback` parameter to the replay API we can leave default unchanged and opt-in tenants for the canary. Example: curl -X POST /internal/replays -d '{"tenant":"beta","window":"2h","tier_hint":"spot_fallback"}'

console-bot: NOTE: Console will display cost + wait estimates if scheduler returns cost_estimate. Format expected: tokens,cost,wait_ms.

ops: Before routing to spot pools we need telemetry tags (replay.routing.tier) and ensure billing counts unchanged. Also submit a short quota request for spot-dedicated for the canary using rb-tool.

peter: Scheduler plan: accept tier_hint behind ff; if spot pool available, assign there with `preemptible=true`. If preempted, auto-retry to shared pool with backoff. Also attach meta.routing_hint=true to events so billing/telemetry see origin.

rashid: For dedupe: enable precheck.dedupe=true for canary tenants. If skip rate > 25% we can safely increase background capacity later.

julia: UX: show toggle "Prefer lower-cost spot pool if available (may be preempted)" and a tooltip linking to docs. Lina from UX can add the copy.

ops: Quota ticket created: rb-tool quota request --tenant beta --pool spot-dedicated-eu --tokens 800000 --hours 2. Monitoring team on standby.

console-bot: Canary started for tenant=beta rp-id=rp-20260401-canary pool=spot-dedicated workers=3 precheck.dedupe=true

peter: Quick safety: if queue_depth.shared > 5000 OR api_p95 > 2x baseline, throttle spot_fallback admissions by 50% and spill to passive queue.

rashid: Also add metric replay.backfill.skip_rate and a dashboard panel correlating skip_rate -> token_savings.

julia: Running the 2h canary. Will post results. If stable, we will template routing_policies for other regions and draft RFC for admission controls. Thanks everyone.
